{{Infobox auto}}

'''Pumpkin jam''' is the preservation of the [[pumpkin]]. It heals {{Value|Pumpkin Jam|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Resistance}} for {{Value|Pumpkin Jam|duration|effect=Resistance}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pumpkin_jam.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Baked Pumpkin|baked pumpkin]], sugar and a glass bottle. Obtaining a baked pumpkin unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating pumpkin jam takes {{Value|Pumpkin Jam|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Pumpkin Jam|heals}} and gives Resistance {{Value|Pumpkin Jam|level|effect=Resistance}} for {{Value|Pumpkin Jam|duration|effect=Resistance|format=clock}}. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.
